name: Big Bang

features.text: Loosens and emulsifies grease and grime
Highly efficient and very economical due to its dilutability.

description: A super concentrated, degreaser that can be used on floors, engines, tires, cars, trucks, machinery, tools, heavy machinery, and transportation equipment. When diluted properly, Big Bang® can be used on interiors as well.
application: Light-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:11 to 1:30 with water. Medium-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:6 to 1:10 with water. Heavy-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:2 to 1:5 with water. 1) Dilute with water and apply with spray bottle or sponge. 2) Spray or wipe diluted solution on surface to be cleaned. 3) If needed, scrub surface with a brush or mop. 4) Rinse surface with clean water. AVOID CONTACT WITH ALUMINUM, MAGNESIUM, AND PAINTED SURFACES, AS SPOTTING OR DAMAGE MAY OCCUR.
